integrity: The theorem is proved symbolically and independently stress-tested by direct finite enumeration for \(3\le n\le12\). Finite checks are not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Minimum weak Roman functions are classified, not all higher-weight functions. Search leaves residual risk of an unindexed equivalent result under crown-graph aliases. The 2003 foundational source was compared via abstract and metadata; detailed full-text comparison used later primary sources.
title: Minimum weak Roman dominating functions of crown graphs
